name: Love is Everywhere
source:
This is a story about a guy named Santiago, early morning, he wakes up to an earthquake! And then after it happens, he decides to help others by becoming a rescue team member.

[From [url=https://xlyph.itch.io/love-is-everywhere]itch.io[/url]]
